en.title: Q
en.summary: The letter Q is part of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter name
paragraphs: The name of this letter is /k/. Its main sound is the sound /kwi.k‿step/, as in (quasar) /kwi.k‿step/, which means quickstep. The letter has only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: Raise the back of your tongue to touch the back of the roof of your mouth. Block the air completely. Release the air suddenly without any voice. Put your hand on your throat to feel that your vocal cords do not vibrate.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: This letter appears only in foreign loanwords and names. It always makes the sound /k/, as in (Qatar) /kaˈtar/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: English words often puff air out after this sound. In Romanian, release the sound cleanly with no extra puff of air. Keep the sound crisp, just like the sound in the English word skin.
